one_line: Thirty-one people, four floors, one boiler and a roof everybody wants in July.
monitor_rationale: reads the boiler meter nightly; four months, then we look again

ladder.label: boiler-hours
ladder.text: The boiler is not run between midnight and six.

shared.label: big-buys
shared.text: Anything bought for the whole building is agreed before it is bought.

access.label: everyone-enters
access.text: Everyone who lives here can open every shared door.

inner_a.label: roof-two-up
inner_a.text: Nobody goes onto the roof alone after dark.

inner_b.label: roof-watered
inner_b.text: Whoever is last on the roof waters the beds.

clash_a.label: quiet-roof
clash_a.text: The roof is quiet after ten, because it is over somebody's bedroom.

clash_b.label: summer-roof
clash_b.text: In July the roof is where the building eats together.

extra.label: chairs-stacked
extra.text: Roof chairs are stacked against the wall when you leave.

policy.root: We decide by consent: one reasoned objection stops a thing, and saying nothing is not an objection. Changing something we have called a principle takes the building, and anything we cannot undo is not decided by silence.
policy.inner: Whoever keeps the roof decides the roof.
policy.unheld: The basement is decided by whoever holds it.
policy.ladder: The first time we ask. The second time the building asks together. The third time the answer is no.
policy.inner_amended: Two of us have to object before a roof thing stops.
policy.middle: Whoever looks after the shared floors decides the shared floors.

inner_proposal.text: put a light on the roof stair and drop the two-up rule after dark
inner_proposal.because: the two-up rule exists because the stair is unlit, and a light removes the reason

inner_objection: the stair is not the only dark thing up there and the rule has never cost anybody an evening

unheld_proposal.text: clear the basement and put bike racks down there

monitor_watch.about: the boiler ran at two in the morning
monitor_watch.because: the meter shows a burn between midnight and six and the rule names those hours
monitor_watch.dismissal: these two do not really conflict

ladder_subject.first: run the boiler overnight while the second floor has no radiators
ladder_subject.second: run the boiler overnight for the guests on the third floor
ladder_subject.third: run the boiler overnight through the cold snap
ladder_subject.because: an overnight burn is heard in every flat on the stack and the rule names those hours
ladder_subject.ruling_1: we let it stand for the week the radiators were out
ladder_subject.ruling_2: the building agreed one more, then no more

other_subject.about: leaving the stair light on all night
other_subject.text: leave the stair light on all night through the winter

clash.about: eating on the roof in July
clash.text: hold the Friday building dinner on the roof through July, finishing at eleven
clash.because_a: eleven on the roof is eleven in the bedroom below it
clash.because_b: the roof in July is the only time the whole building is in one place
clash.carried: the flat below is Yara's and Yara cooks the dinner; it stops being carried the day somebody else lives there, which is why it has a date on it

amend_convention.text: leave the roof chairs out through the summer instead of stacking them
amend_convention.because: stacking them every night in July is work nobody has ever finished

amend_principle.text: move roof quiet from ten to eleven between June and August
amend_principle.because: the summer is the only time the roof is worth having

irreversible.text: scrap the old boiler for the metal price once the new one is in

silence.about: who takes a parcel in for somebody out at work
silence.rationale: everyone already does it, and the first person to write it down would make it a shift rather than a favour
silence.proposal: put a parcel duty on the floor rota

panel.rationale: three people to look at the roof rule for a month
